job: Ask for the one next step near the end of a page: a band, an inset panel, or a title beside a one-field form.
purpose: band: a full-width ground with a title and actions, the home of the texture and inverse grounds. card: an inset panel inside the container. split: a title at the start and, at the end, actions or the one sign-up form (fd-field, a consent line, its states set by site.js). The same form also sits in the footer's sign-up column and at an article's foot.
useWhen: The end of a landing page, before the footer.
A newsletter or waitlist sign-up (split with a form).
The opening of a newsletter page, where signing up is the reason for the page.

avoidWhen.when: A message that needs attention in the app.

states.name: invalid
states.how: data-state="invalid": aria-invalid="true" on the input and its fd-field-error

states.name: busy
states.how: data-state="busy": aria-busy="true" on the button, the input read-only

states.name: sent
states.how: data-state="sent": the field gives way to .fd-site-cta-done[data-state="sent"] (role="status")

states.name: subscribed
states.how: data-state="subscribed": the address is already on the list; .fd-site-cta-done[data-state="subscribed"]

states.name: failed
states.how: data-state="failed": the field stays and its error (role="alert") holds data-error-failed

variants.useWhen: A closing band on its own ground.
An inset panel on a page that is already busy with grounds.
A title and a form or actions side by side.

parts.role: One line on what the address is used for, with the privacy link.
